svg.aria-label: Engraved certificate for Liangebra, Mathematics and Applied Mathematics: who has made 513 contributions on 24 days of the past twelve months, with a longest run of 5 days, and has held a public account since 2025. A guilloché medallion with the monogram L, its outer ring swelling in the busiest months, and a vermilion seal dated 2025. Serial L-2025-000513.
